s: an iconic Bristol bike-shop café above the working harbourside
w: A full bike workshop downstairs, café upstairs on the Harbourside since the 1990s -- one of the originals in the bike-shop-café format, well before it became a recognised genre. Coffee and hearty food for riders refuelling after a loop, with harbour views and enough history that regulars talk about the place as a Bristol institution rather than just a stop.
_facts: Located at 40 The Grove, Wapping Wharf, Harbourside, Bristol BS1 4RB
Combines a full-service bike workshop/shop with a café upstairs
One of the UK's early bike-shop-and-café combinations
